# Quick reference {#sec-quick-reference}

**Aim:** bring 3 pieces to the opposite side (@sec-aim).

**Your turn:** 3 actions.

| Action    | Cost | Level 4+ cost |
|-----------|-----:|--------------:|
| Move      | 1    | 1             |
| Split     | 1    | 1             |
| Entangle  | 2    | 2             |
| Measure   | 1    | 2             |

**Measurement die:** 1–3 first marker, 4–6 second marker.
